screening.enumerationMeaning: identity combinations, not a count of playable or recommended teams
screening.boundary: Default screening uses positive applicable evidence and hard constraints; optional passive inactivity, specialty count and field-time priors are not universal game-legality rules. Reviewed unconventional and dual-carry teams are preserved. Only the chosen team proceeds to inventory solving.

artifact.boundary: Applicable source/local coarse bands after mechanism and formed-condition review; reviewed preference only within a band. Display traversal is not an exact strength rank. Model-only teams remain selectable exploration. No full timeline, exact DPS, independent accuracy or global optimality is claimed.
